code-intel.description: code-intel: source-read-only agent query surface, never gate authority. get_gate_verdict / get_facts / get_evidence / get_audit_status project committed runs; get_change_impact compares the committed import graph against live --repo-path and labels stale-advisory; optional get_code_context queries an explicitly indexed, snapshot-bound local CodeGraph and writes evidence outside the source repo, never indexing or syncing implicitly; plan_structural_edit and scan_security_findings scan the live checkout without source mutation. --repo is the committed-run alias; --repo-path defaults to the working directory.

repowise.description: repowise: codebase intelligence — docs, graph, git signals, dead code, decisions
